jobs.description: Coherent Corp is the global leader in photonics, designing and manufacturing advanced laser, optical, and materials technologies. Our innovations power semiconductor manufacturing, AI infrastructure, advanced communications, and precision industrial systems worldwide. With a global footprint and cutting-edge manufacturing and R&D, we’re shaping the future of high-tech industries.In Germany, our teams are at the heart of Europe’s photonics and industrial laser ecosystem, combining engineering excellence, advanced manufacturing, and applied R&D to deliver high-precision laser and optical solutions for automotive, semiconductor, electronics, and advanced manufacturing customers worldwide.The Role:We are looking for a Production Team Leader to lead a small production team while ensuring manufacturing activities are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required quality standards. You will play a key role in production planning, resource coordination, team development and continuous improvement, working closely with technical experts and cross-functional teams to achieve operational goals.You will be responsible for:- Leading, motivating and developing a team of production employees to achieve operational, quality and safety objectives.- Planning and coordinating daily and weekly production activities, including capacity planning, work-in-progress (WIP) order management, production scheduling and material availability.- Leading regular stand-up meetings, team meetings and one-to-one discussions to communicate priorities, review performance and support employee development.- Collaborating with technical experts, shift coordinators and other departments to coordinate production activities and plan future workloads.- Monitoring production performance and KPIs, identifying issues and escalating risks where appropriate.- Driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, quality and operational efficiency.- Supporting audits and ensuring compliance with company standards and manufacturing processes.About You:You are an organised and proactive leader with experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment. You enjoy developing people, improving processes and working collaboratively to achieve operational excellence.You will also have:- At least one year's experience leading a team of approximately 3–8 employees.- Experience within a production, manufacturing or industrial environment.- A technical qualification or technical education.- A strong technical mindset with an understanding of manufacturing processes.- Experience with production planning, KPI monitoring and performance management.- Experience supporting continuous improvement initiatives and audits.- Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.- Fluent German and a good standard of written and spoken English.Ensure adherence to the company's values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position:• Integrity – Create an Environment of Trust• Collaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas• Accountability – Own the Process and the Outcome• Respect – Recognize the Value in Everyone• Enthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in WorkApplication & SelectionCurrent employees who wish to apply should submit a cover letter detailing their interest in the position and how their skills and experience align with the requirements of the role.If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the application process, please reach out to kris.cairns@coherent.com. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds.Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte Personen

About HeraeusMaking displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.About Heraeus MedevioHeraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. The position supports building of prototypes and test samples using rapid prototyping techniques and collaborates actively with engineering, the tool shop and the test center.The following challenges await you:- Design and development of mechanical products, fixtures and tooling using design-to-assembly and design-to-manufacture principles, using SolidWorks- Creation and evaluation of technical drawings for new designs, including the evaluation of the specified dimensions, tolerances and other specifications.- Evaluation and update of drawings during product life cycle.- Support of the product design and process development departments to improve the manufacturability of products and tools as well as other development related tasks.- Consultation and development to improve compliance with standards in component design- Support the building of rapid prototyping samples, using 3D printing, manual assembly and other rapid prototyping techniques.- Maintenance of the 3D printing equipment and material stock.- Occasional travel to other Medevio sites or business partners.Your profile:- Mechanical engineering degree or comparable degree.- Experience with plastic part design and design for injection molding, preferred experience with disposable sterile medical devices.- Experience with tool and fixture design, preferred with mold tool design.- Experience with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing, preferred with ISO GPS.- Very good skills working with the appropriate 3D model software, preferred SolidWorks.- High level of communication skill in English language, written, spoken.- MS Office skills.Curious? Apply now!We are interested in finding the best candidates, and they may come from a nontraditional background. So please don’t hesitate to apply, even if you aren’t an exact fit. We look forward to getting you started on your employment journey with Heraeus Medevio!Any further questions?Our Recruiting Team, Heraeus Medevio, is happy to assist you by email: recruiting.medevio@heraeus.com. We are looking for a Senior Global Pricing Operations Partner (m/f/d) who is analytical, strategic and collaborative to join us in our Pricing Operations and Analytics team.About the roleAs Senior Global Pricing Operations Partner, you will lead the end-to-end assessment of complex and strategically important pricing requests. You will guide affiliates and global stakeholders on pricing governance, processes and tools while evaluating financial and cross-market implications. You will develop pricing policies for key brands, ensure high-quality pricing data and translate complex analyses into clear recommendations. In addition, you will lead strategic pricing operations projects, improve digital workflows and support the development of other Pricing Operations Partners.Who you’ll work withYou will work in a global, cross-functional environment, partnering closely with affiliates and regional and global stakeholders. This includes country pricing and market access teams, regional Access and Pricing teams, Global Asset Teams (including the Asset Payer Heads), Global Strategic Pricing and Finance. As a key Pricing Operations contact, you will support business-case owners throughout pricing assessments and collaborate with relevant governance stakeholders (Regional and Global Pricing Committees and Pricing Board) on critical pricing decisions. You will also coach Pricing Operations Partners, providing guidance and ensuring consistently high-quality analyses and submissions. You will report to the Global Pricing Operations Team Lead.What you’ll do- You are the main global point of contact for operational pricing questions and processes of your assigned affiliates.- You guide affiliates to build business cases with the necessary analytics, ensure stakeholder alignment and keep all teams on track with decision-making timelines.- You assess the financial and cross-market implications and risks of pricing requests and escalate them when needed.- You develop in-market pricing policies for assigned brands.- You monitor price changes, ensure pricing decisions are documented and up to date in the system, and provide quarterly reports on price changes and their impact.- You lead strategic projects to improve pricing tools, processes, automation and digital workflows, while coaching Pricing Operations Partners to ensure high-quality analyses and submissions.Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills- Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, economics, finance, business or data analytics.- At least five years’ relevant pricing, market access, health economics or finance experience.- Strong pharmaceutical pricing expertise, including governance and cross-market implications.- Proven experience leading complex, high-impact or cross-market pricing cases.- Strong analytical, project management, stakeholder management and communication skills.- Excellent written and verbal English skills in global, cross-functional environments.

mit SAP FI und angrenzenden Anwendungen sicher.- Du treibst die Standardisierung, Automatisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Prozesse in einer internationalen Organisation voran.- Du unterstützt SAP-Implementierungen, Rollouts, Weiterentwicklungen und Transformationsprojekte.- Du arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen, IT-Teams und externen Partnern an unseren internationalen Standorten zusammen.Dein Profil- Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich SAP FI/CO, mit einem klaren Schwerpunkt auf SAP Controlling (CO).- Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Produktkostenrechnung, Kostenstellenrechnung, Innenaufträgen, CO-PA, Planung, Budgetierung, Forecasting und Reporting mit.- Du hast praktische Erfahrung im Customizing von SAP CO sowie ein gutes Verständnis der Integration zwischen FI und CO.- Du hast Erfahrung mit SAP ECC und SAP S/4HANA, idealerweise im Rahmen einer S/4HANA-Transformation oder -Migration.- Erfahrung in einem produzierenden oder industriellen Unternehmen ist von Vorteil.- Du verstehst komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen und kannst diese in pragmatische und nachhaltige SAP-Lösungen übersetzen.- Du überzeugst durch Kommunikationsstärke und ein sicheres Stakeholder-Management in einem internationalen Umfeld.- Eine proaktive, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein zeichnen dich aus.- Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.Unser Erfolg basiert auf Zusammenarbeit – wir fördern vielfältiges Denken, hören einander zu und schätzen jede einzelne Stimme. Kreativität entfaltet sich bei Kelvion dort, wo Menschen gehört, ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen und ihre Beiträge anerkannt werden.Mit einem flexiblen Arbeitsansatz stellen wir das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden in den Mittelpunkt. Dies stärkt die Bereitschaft sich einzubringen und eröffnet damit neue Karrierechancen Wir ermutigen engagierte Persönlichkeiten ihre Entwicklung selbst in die Hand zu nehmen, neue Wege zu gehen und gemeinsam mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten.Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsamEnglish VersionOur mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. Overview   At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.  We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you.  At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact.  Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. ‎About the opportunity At QIAGEN, we are committed to making improvements in life possible. As a Packaging Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, industrializing, and continuously improving packaging solutions across our Diagnostics and Life Sciences portfolio. As a subject matter expert for packaging technologies, you will provide technical guidance to R&D, Operations, Quality, Procurement, manufacturing partners, and suppliers, ensuring robust, scalable, compliant, and cost-effective solutions throughout the product lifecycle. Combining packaging development, supplier engineering, manufacturing implementation, and automation, you will contribute to new product introductions, drive packaging innovation, and support automation projects across our global manufacturing and supplier network. Your tasks include * Leading packaging development and industrialization for new and existing products, from concept and material selection through qualification and commercial implementation.* Driving packaging automation projects at QIAGEN and supplier sites, including equipment implementation, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ activities.* Providing technical packaging expertise to R&D, Operations, Quality, Procurement, manufacturing sites, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.* Optimizing packaging materials and processes for product protection, quality, sustainability, regulatory compliance, efficiency, and cost.* Driving continuous improvement, root cause investigations, standardization, and the evaluation and implementation of innovative packaging technologies. Your profile * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.* Several years of relevant experience in packaging engineering, packaging development, manufacturing engineering, supplier engineering, or industrialization.* Strong expertise in packaging materials, technologies, manufacturing processes, and transport requirements, ideally including ISTA and IATA.* Experience with automated packaging equipment and equipment implementation, including FAT/SAT and DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ, preferably within a GMP or similarly regulated environment.* Experience managing technical projects and collaborating with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional teams; experience in diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or life sciences is an advantage.* Knowledge of packaging qualification, risk management, FMEA, DoE, process capability, sustainability, and global manufacturing transfer is advantageous.* Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with fluent English; German is an advantage and occasional travel is expected.What we offer   * Bonus/Commission  * Local benefits   * Referral Program  * Volunteer Day  * Internal Academy (QIALearn)   * Employee Assistance Program   * Hybrid work (conditional to your role)  Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.    QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.
